entries.classification_evidence: detected_backends requires uniqueItems=true and items drawn from the two-value enum {git, jujutsu} (Plans/source_control_contracts.schema.json:184-188). Any array of three or more items therefore repeats a permitted value (uniqueItems) or adds a value outside the enum (item enum), so no input violates maxItems=2 alone. maxItems stays in the schema as owner text; its removal changes no acceptance (phase-1 review W3B-sol F1, 3,906-array probe). Isolated negatives exist for uniqueItems (schema/17) and the item enum; phase 2's shared guard-isolation tool records this site as implied, not as a duplicate.
